question: In a certain code language, ‘MANAGE’ is coded as ‘HJDQDP’. What is the code for ‘LATTER’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/803e83129e54c67df501d55c3c829ab4c3ca99be908ecb7aea55ce7fa5eed5ee.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘MANAGE’ is coded as ‘HJDQDP’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0bf11a6485f1768a70d63c087220edabf839adeb3e8e579421eaabc067272df.png] 

Similarly, for LATTER:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cb9050a67e85d7688e01689cfdc6c4a553324d5aa5ac94c928802db7d54921a.png] 

So, LATTER will be coded as UHWWDO.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
